brief: 6 agency new-business tactics that filled our pipeline in 2026 without cold email.

slots.subtitle: Six modern tactics that replaced cold email for good.

slots.body: We turned the CEO's LinkedIn into a daily insights flywheel. Hot takes on client problems attracted inbound DMs from qualified prospects within 30 days.
We built a tiered network with non-competing agencies and freelancers. Every partner received a revenue share, creating a self-sustaining pipeline of warm introductions.
We hosted free, tactical sessions solving one painful problem for our ideal client. Attendees saw our expertise firsthand and converted to retainers at sixty percent.
We identified twenty niche shows our prospects already trusted. Each appearance positioned us as category experts and drove listeners to a dedicated landing page.
We co-marketed with emerging SaaS tools our audience was adopting. Their customer success teams introduced us directly to brands needing implementation support immediately.
We launched an invite-only Slack group for marketing leaders. The peer-to-peer value built trust, and natural conversations converted into project briefs without pitching.
Steal these tactics and rebuild your pipeline without cold email. Follow for weekly growth plays.
